note: Phase 7 Breakdown. Owner: @pm throughout. Two skills post-WS5-E: `story-slice` (merges the former create-epics + create-stories) slices the three-way-keyed architecture (PRD × components × ADRs) into epics + atomic ST-*.md story contracts (owns/produces/consumes, o/m/p, risk, acceptance-stubs); `story-graph` (rebuilt from parallelization-strategy) authors story-graph.yaml + runs `coldpress waves` (computed waves/critical-path/schedule) + the tracking file. Reads architecture (Phase 6 sacred) + PRD + UX-spec + tokens/styleguide + ADRs + api-contract + security-registry + analytics-plan. **Architecture-deltas reconciliation** happens at Phase 6 EXIT (`phase-transition` step-02a §B). **PERT retired** — the computed wave plan supersedes the old sacred PERT chart. Exit: 9-point implementation-readiness gate.
entry_conditions: Phase 6 (Architecture) gate passed (incl. silent-divergence guard at #5)
ADRs from Phase 3 + Phase 6 present at `_context/planning/adrs/`
UX spec + brand-guidelines validated; prototype manifest exists
`_context/handoffs/phase-6-to-7-{date}.md` exists, with a fully-resolved `architecture_deltas:` section (every entry has `user_decision` set — reconciled at Phase 6 exit, not a Phase 7 entry step)

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/sacred/architecture.md` is locked + sacred (re-verified at Phase 7 exit)
acceptance_checks.remediation: If architecture changed mid-Phase-7, re-enter Phase 6 architecture-design OR run architecture-deltas reconciliation via `phase-transition` step-02a §B.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/epics-v{latest}.md` exists, validates against schema, sidecar `.meta.json` exists
`_context/implementation/stories/story-NNN-*-v{N}.md` files exist (per-story files per Q4); `stories-index.md` aggregates; all schema-valid
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm story-slice` (Steps 2-3 emit per-story contracts + red stubs).

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/implementation/story-graph.yaml` exists, schema-validates, and `coldpress waves` accepts it (acyclic; every interface edge has a contract story; intra-wave ownership disjoint)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm story-graph` (emits story-graph.yaml + runs `coldpress waves`). PERT chart retired — the computed wave plan supersedes it.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/tracking/sprint-status-v{latest}.md` exists; every story assigned to a wave
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm story-graph` (Step 5 generates the tracking file from the computed wave assignment).

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/audit/implementation-readiness-v{latest}.md` exists; 9-point structured checklist all pass (per Q6: PRD coverage / UX coverage / architecture coverage / flagged-deltas resolved at Phase 6 / PERT valid / sprint complete / no ADR contradictions / prototype available / legacy reflected)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm implementation-readiness`. If any check fails, address the upstream gap and re-run.

acceptance_checks.description: Every PRD user-story-ID is referenced in ≥1 story (verified by implementation-readiness check #1)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Revise stories to cover uncovered PRD user-stories OR surface as architecture-delta + reconciliation.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/handoffs/phase-7-to-8-{date}.md` exists, valid against extended phase-handoff schema

`coldpress trace orphans` reports no blocking findings — the story graph is acyclic and consistent (no dangling `consumes`, no unresolved deltas). (§4.6 P7 orphan gate; story-without-stub coverage activates with WS4 acceptance-stubs.) Also run `coldpress waves` to validate the DAG + contract stories + ownership disjointness.
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `coldpress trace orphans` (resolve dependencies/deltas) and `coldpress waves` (fix cycles / missing contract stories / ownership overlaps).
